title: Breadcrumbs
description: Fiori breadcrumbs with responsive leading overflow, UI5 separator styles and arrow-key navigation.

usage.summary: Show the current location and let users return to ancestors in the navigation path.
useWhen: Help users understand their location after drilling down and return to an ancestor.
Use a consistent hierarchy across pages; for fixed hierarchies, show the same path regardless of how users arrived.

avoidWhen.when: Choose application modules or primary destinations rather than return along a location path.
Switch between content facets within the current page.
